verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions official client SDKs or libraries for building against Elastic Observability programmatically. The only nearby items are APM language agents, which are instrumentation libraries, and the ES|QL REST API, which is a raw HTTP building block. Neither is an official SDK, so neither earns credit. EDOT is described only as telemetry collection, not as an SDK for building against the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
